data.one_liner: Library to ping IP subnets and discover local network devices and services.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to scan an IP subnet to discover active network devices and services on specific ports. It provides methods to ping addresses either sequentially or all at once using Dart streams.
use_when: You need to discover network printers or other local hardware in a Wi-Fi network
You want to scan a local subnet for active IP addresses on specific ports
avoid_when: You need advanced network diagnostic tools beyond basic subnet pinging
Devices are not connected to a local Wi-Fi network
strengths: Simple stream-based API for network discovery
Supports checking single ports, port ranges, and subnets
weaknesses: Requires devices to be connected to Wi-Fi
data.setup_notes: The device must be connected to a Wi-Fi network.
